title: Saree Draping
summary: A saree is a long unstitched drape (about 5–6 metres) worn over a petticoat and blouse. The common Nivi style tucks it at the waist, forms front pleats and drapes the pallu over the left shoulder; Bengali 'aatpoure' style drapes without front pleats.
steps: Tuck the plain end into the petticoat at the right of the navel and wrap once around
Make 5–7 pleats and tuck them at the centre
Take the rest around and pleat or drape the pallu over the left shoulder
